title: Shishak sacks the Temple in Rehoboam's fifth year
summary: Shishak king of Egypt takes the treasures of the Temple and the king's house in the fifth year of Rehoboam; CFAH identifies Shishak with Thutmose in his 30th year.
description: Shishak king of Egypt takes the treasures of the Temple and the king's house in the fifth year of Rehoboam; CFAH identifies Shishak with Thutmose in his 30th year. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 971 BC (AP-65, OSF preprint CFAH-8)

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-8: Placing Dynasties 15-18," OSF preprint v1.2 (29 Apr 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/Z5RTD, file CFAH-8_v1.2.pdf, p. 37 ("Anchor Point #65 Thutmose Year 30, Shishak Sack of the Temple, Rehoboam Year 5 in 971 BC")
chronologies.note: CFAH identifies Shishak with Thutmose (year 30); the synchronism is with the 5th year of Rehoboam.

chronologies.date: Sesostris, or Sesac, besieging Jerusalem in the fifth year of Rehoboam, A. M. 3033
chronologies.citation: Shuckford, The Sacred and Profane History of the World Connected, 5th ed., revised by James Creighton (London: William Baynes, 1819), vol. 1, Book IV, p. 186 (facsimile PDF p. 282)
chronologies.note: He equates Sesostris and Sesac with this siege. The event record is the sacking of the Temple in that same fifth year. The year is not Rehoboam’s accession.
